title: Nikola Bartunkova beats Aryna Sabalenka at China Open
summary:
Nikola Bartunkova earned a surprise win over world number two Aryna Sabalenka at the China Open, according to a report published on 4 October 2026. The Czech player, ranked 34th in the world, won 6-4, 6-3 and will face Austria’s Sinja Kraus next.

Bartunkova said she focused on herself and tried to stay calm during the match. She described Sabalenka as a legend and said she was very happy to have won. The result continued what the report described as Bartunkova’s breakthrough season.

Sabalenka’s defeat came a day after top seed Elena Rybakina lost to Armenia’s Alina Charaeva, who is ranked 118th. Rybakina had beaten Sabalenka in last month’s US Open final and replaced her at the top of the world rankings.

This is the first time since 2015 that the China Open’s top two seeds have both missed the round of 16. Seeds are players given leading positions in a tournament’s draw based on their rankings.

Sabalenka had five chances to win a game on Bartunkova’s serve, known as break points, but did not take any of them. She has now lost six matches in a row in which she lost the opening set.

Her most recent titles came in March, when she won Indian Wells and the Miami Open back-to-back. Winning both events is known as the “Sunshine Double”.
why_it_matters: The 34th-ranked Bartunkova defeated world number two Sabalenka, continuing what the report called her breakthrough season. Together with Rybakina’s defeat, the result left both top seeds outside the round of 16 for the first time since 2015.
